item.title: WWA EUROPEAN Wakesurf Championships | 2025 SPAIN
item.description: The World Wake Association (WWA) and Nautique Boats are thrilled to announce the return of the European Wakesurf Championships in 2025, this time at a brand-new venue in Spain. Riders, fans, and watersports enthusiasts are invited to Botaski, just outside Madrid, on July 26–27, 2025, for what promises to be the most electrifying European wakesurf showdown yet. The post WWA EUROPEAN Wakesurf Championships | 2025 SPAIN appeared first on Unleashed Wake Mag.

item.title: Voltaic Marine Enters the Game with the AEW24
item.description: Voltaic Marine is launching the AEW24, an aluminum-hulled electric wakesports boat that's more than just another clean-energy vessel. Built from the ground up with a 300kW powertrain and scalable platform architecture, it's designed to revolutionize everything from weekend riding to military applications.
